verdict.rationale: Solo 2 keeps passkeys on the hardware key rather than in a vendor cloud. The vendor's release notes document wiping the device with `fido2-token -R`, which gives coarse, whole-device deletion of stored credentials. Deletion is only shown as a full reset through a host-side libfido2 tool, and no finer-grained retention controls are documented. Missing for 10: per-credential or per-app deletion, documented retention controls across the OATH/PIV/OpenPGP apps, first-party CLI support for wipe/reset, and independent hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Solo 2 supports the passkey standard — except yours stays on your key. Not their cloud.
